sentences: 32-bit LDS atomics lowered inside `Gen.lds_op` via a Workgroup-scope `OpAtomicCompareExchange` CAS loop (no shader float atomic extension needed): `ds_inc_u32` gives `(M >= DATA) ? 0 : M + 1` (unsigned), `ds_dec_u32` gives `(M == 0 || M > DATA) ? DATA : M - 1` (unsigned), `ds_rsub_u32` gives `DATA - M` (wrapping), and `ds_{min,max}_f32` use GLSL.std.450 `NMin`/`NMax` (NaN returns the non-NaN operand, `-0.0 < +0.0`, matching `global_atomic_fmin`/`fmax`).
The `_rtn_` forms return the pre-op word in `vdst`; inactive lanes skip the op and preserve `vdst`.
Source: AMD RDNA2 ISA DS encoding.

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_lds_atomics_cas.py` (edge value grids, NaN/±0/±inf, `offset:`, `vdst` aliasing, inactive lanes, sequential wraparound, Workgroup CAS loop structure, outside-compute and bad-operand rejections).
